        r^=l
        for rr in range(4):
            mx=ff((r^K[rr])&0xFFFFFFFF); tmp=r; r=(l^mx)&0xFFFFFFFF; l=tmp
        l^=r
        return ((r&0xFFFFFFFF)<<32)|(l&0xFFFFFFFF)
